svg.title: The RenewableSwitchOver shield, top view, rendered from its KiCad board file
svg.text: Top view, rendered from the KiCad board file (SSE_SurfaceMount.kicad_pcb).
Lighter green under the solder mask is copper: the ground pours and the tracks.
JP1 and JP2 are left open: fit a shunt on each to choose PWM (L298N) or Direct drive, as marked on the silkscreen.
JP3 and JP4 are shown bridged, as in the schematic. The Arduino Uno plugs in underneath.
